Arrow Systems at LabelEXPO 2018

[name] Experience at PackEXPO 2017

[name] hosted a booth at PackEXPO 2017 to show off the ANYCUT I laser finisher, as well as the Any-002 Label printer and Anyblade 13” blade finisher to a new segment. The systems were well received, especially the Any-002 and ANYCUT I laser finisher.

World of Concrete 2017 – Arrow Systems Display

[name] and KERAjet hosted a joint booth at World of Concrete to show off the latest in digital decoration for building materials. At WoC we had full displays of digitally printed granite, concrete, fiber cement, wood, and medium density fiberboard. The amount of interest in digitally printed building materials was extremely high and is resulting in a change in the way producers design new products.

Arrow Systems, Inc. at LabelEXPO 2016

Arrow Systems, Inc. attends LabelEXPO 2016 as the distribution arm for the Anytron brand of printers and laser finishers. The show was a resounding success where we showed off our Anycut I and Anycut III laser die cutters, in addition to the Anyblade 13” blade finisher and Any-002 Laser printer.
